_fixture: Two records of the same kind claiming one address. Synthetic contract example: the ids are invented, the text asserts nothing about insurance, and nothing here is loaded by the site.
_why: This is the realistic shape of the failure. Two files in one directory cannot share a name, so a collision does not arise from the filesystem - it arises when something merges record sets, which is exactly what a future provider adapter or a candidate-import step will do.
